explanation: Shrunk minimal case has no pushes and no sensor noise: heavy pole (0.5kg), high gravity (15), initial theta=0.2/omega=0.5. Controller keeps pole nearly upright (theta~0.05 at step 128) with small positive force ~1.2N, but allows steady cart drift with v~1.27-1.38 m/s from step 120 to 128, driving x from 2.19 to 2.40+. It prioritizes pole balance over cart centering and never brakes/reverses, so cart exits track.
